text_en: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? Wisdom makes one’s face shine, and the hardness of one’s countenance is changed.
text_cn: 有谁相似智者，有谁会解释事理？智慧使人的面容焕发，使严肃的容貌变为温和。

text_en: Keep the king’s command because of your sacred oath.
text_cn: 为了向天主起的誓，你应遵守君王的命令；

text_en: Do not be terrified; go from his presence, do not delay when the matter is unpleasant, for he does whatever he pleases.
text_cn: 你不可由他面前仓猝离去；也不可行恶，因为凡他喜欢的事，都可随意执行。

text_en: For the word of the king is powerful, and who can say to him, “What are you doing? ”
text_cn: 原来君王的话具有威力，谁敢向他说：“你做什么？”

text_en: Whoever obeys a command will meet no harm, and the wise mind will know the time and way.
text_cn: 遵守诫命的，不会遇到灾祸；智者的心能辨识时机和审断。

text_en: For every matter has its time and way, although the troubles of mortals lie heavy upon them.
text_cn: 的确，事事都有定时和定案；但重大的负担仍压在人身上，

text_en: Indeed, they do not know what is to be, for who can tell them how it will be?
text_cn: 因为人不知道将来要发生什么事，有谁能告诉他，何时要发生？

text_en: No one has power over the wind to restrain the wind, or power over the day of death; there is no discharge from the battle, nor does wickedness deliver those who practice it.
text_cn: 没有人有权将生气保留不失，也没有人能支配死期；战场上没有人能退役，邪恶救不了作恶的人。

text_en: All this I observed, applying my mind to all that is done under the sun, while one person exercises authority over another to the other’s hurt.
text_cn: 我看见了这一切，专心研究在太阳下所行的一切事：有时统治人的人，自受其害；

text_en: Then I saw the wicked buried; they used to go in and out of the holy place, and were praised in the city where they had done such things. This also is vanity.
text_cn: 有时我看见恶人被抬去安葬，而行义的人却离开圣处，而在城中被人遗忘：这也是虚幻。

text_en: Because sentence against an evil deed is not executed speedily, the human heart is fully set to do evil.
text_cn: 因为惩恶的定案未有迅速执行，世人因此充满了行恶的偏向。

text_en: Though sinners do evil a hundred times and prolong their lives, yet I know that it will be well with those who fear God, because they stand in fear before him,
text_cn: 恶人虽百次行恶，仍享长寿，姑且不论；我确实知道，那敬畏天主的人，因他们在天主前起敬起畏，必得幸福；

text_en: but it will not be well with the wicked, neither will they prolong their days like a shadow, because they do not stand in fear before God.
text_cn: 而恶人必得不到幸福，他的时日如影，决不能久长，因为他不敬畏天主。

text_en: There is a vanity that takes place on earth, that there are righteous people who are treated according to the conduct of the wicked, and there are wicked people who are treated according to the conduct of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.
text_cn: 在世上还有一件虚幻的事：就是义人所遭遇的，反如恶人所应得的；而恶人所遭遇的，反如义人所应得的；我遂说：这也是虚幻。

text_en: So I commend enjoyment, for there is nothing better for people under the sun than to eat, and drink, and enjoy themselves, for this will go with them in their toil through the days of life that God gives them under the sun.
text_cn: 为此，我称赞快乐，因为在太阳下，人除了吃喝行乐外，别无幸福；因为这是人在天主赏他在太阳下的一生岁月内，从他的劳苦中，所获得的幸福。

text_en: When I applied my mind to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on earth, how one’s eyes see sleep neither day nor night,
text_cn: 当我专心追求智慧，观察人在世上，连黑夜白日都不能闭目安眠，所行的工作时，

text_en: then I saw all the work of God, that no one can find out what is happening under the sun. However much they may toil in seeking, they will not find it out; even though those who are wise claim to know, they cannot find it out.
text_cn: 我面对天主的一切作为，发觉人决不能知道在太阳下所发生的一切事。人虽然努力研究，终归无法得知；纵然有智者以为知道了，仍是一无所知。
